source.title: Modified classical orthogonal polynomials associated with oscillating functions—open problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with identifier 699066. Direct fetching of https://zbmath.org/699066 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, so the zbMATH API was used only as resolver metadata. The exact zbMATH record is Pascal Maroni, "Modified classical orthogonal polynomials associated with oscillating functions—open problems", Applied Numerical Mathematics 15(2), pages 259-283, 1994, DOI 10.1016/0168-9274(94)00022-0.

failure_mode=blocked_or_challenged; secondary_failure_mode=paywalled_or_restricted. The DOI resolved to Elsevier/ScienceDirect for PII 0168927494000220. The ScienceDirect PDF endpoint returned HTTP 403. The Elsevier article retrieval API returned only core metadata with openaccess=0, openaccessArticle=false, and openArchiveArticle=false, not readable full text.

Bounded exact-work recovery checked Crossref by DOI, OpenAlex by DOI, and exact-title web searches. Crossref returned only DOI/resource links and Elsevier TDM API links; OpenAlex reported is_oa=false, oa_status=closed, best_oa_location=null, and any_repository_has_fulltext=false. Exact-title searches found the ScienceDirect abstract/metadata page, author/profile metadata, citation lists, and related papers, but no readable same-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.

No accepted questions were produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements was recovered. Extracting from zbMATH/Crossref/OpenAlex metadata, abstracts, search snippets, citations, or related papers would violate the source adequacy and evidence coverage gates.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/699066.json and outputs/latest.json.
